title: Cleaning board
intro: Every room's cleaning state, live on one screen — rooms flag themselves at checkout and each morning, your team works the board.
readOnlyHint: Your subscription is read-only — renew to make changes.

noAccess.title: No access to housekeeping
noAccess.hint: Your role doesn't include viewing the cleaning board. Ask a manager if you need access.

hint.title: The board fills itself
hint.body: When a guest checks out, the room flags itself for a checkout clean. Every morning at your daily service hour, occupied rooms flag themselves for daily service — skipping Do-Not-Disturb rooms. You only flag manually for exceptions.

sound.on: New-flag sound is on — click to mute
sound.off: New-flag sound is muted — click to enable

empty.allClearHint: Nothing waiting right now — rooms flag themselves here the moment they need attention.
empty.filteredHint: Try clearing a filter or two.

modal.title: Room {room}
modal.dndStartBlocked: The guest has switched on Do-Not-Disturb — cleaning can start after it lifts.

flagForm.title: Flag this room for cleaning
flagForm.parkedHint: The flag is kept but the room stays parked under Do-Not-Disturb until the guest releases it.

interruptForm.title: Why was the cleaning stopped?
interruptForm.placeholder: e.g. the guest returned and asked to come back later

assignForm.title: Assign to
assignForm.empty: No staff members can work the cleaning queue yet — grant a role the "Work the cleaning queue" permission first.

settings.title: Housekeeping settings
settings.intro: When the morning round starts, and everything else about how the board runs itself.

dailyServiceTime.label: Daily service time
dailyServiceTime.hint: Each day at this hour (hotel time), occupied rooms are flagged for daily service and Do-Not-Disturb lifts.
